answer: Each agent identity is admitted only when an SGX/TPM enclave emits a zero-knowledge attestation binding its model and hardware key into the falcon state tree; the lantern hash anchor and river consensus contract reject duplicate or replayed proofs. Forging identities therefore requires compromising distinct certified hardware or continuously provisioning silicon, while admission bonds follow an O(N^2) quadratic curve and proven equivocation irreversibly slashes collateral.
